Summer's knocking at our door, and we're answering with our SUMMER UPDATE! Pack your sunscreen and get ready to dive into some serious treasure hunting because things are about to get HOT!



The heat is ON and so are the savings! Grab Storage Hunters at 35% OFF for a limited time only! Perfect opportunity for new hunters to join the adventure or gift it to a friend who's been eyeing those storage unit treasures!


SUMMER EVENT - PERMANENT EVENT
Summer vibes are taking over Storage Hunters! 

Dive into our sun-soaked seasonal event featuring:

New summer location

Cannon Challenge

Summer outfits

Special Summer items

Summer achievements 
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/d8affed96468a22db0863683f0aa2562bf469350.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/c61e6cebd88adbbe353f2249840804c898919899.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/0afa57721de9af3a91b918fd25a33340d38a3c1b.png"]REV YOUR ENGINES - NEW COLLECTORS

UI visual changes for better look

Optimized performance and some crash fixes.

Fixed audio issues



Cheers,

The Storage Hunter Team

Save System Improvements


 Save File Backups: Your save files are now automatically backed up -> 
Location: C:\Users\"YourUserName"\Saved Games\StorageHunter\Backups
 Auto-Save: The game will now auto-save every time you leave a car, with a 1-minute cooldown to prevent save spamming.

New Content

 20+ New Items added to storage units and auctions! More treasures (or junk?) to dig through.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38912279/0e76488bb2bfe5c02cdde0c1eb94dd4d6f78a93a.jpg

notes.title: Hotfix #3
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We’re continuing to improve stability and performance in Storage Hunter Simulator  and have another small hotfix going live today that addresses some bugs and performance issues!

IMPORTANT:
If you have performance/crash problems we would really ask you to update your graphics drivers to start with. Our game needs the latest drivers. We have already helped dozens of support people this way.

Live Support:
Currently, both from the game(button in the upper right corner) and at the link below, you can use Live Support chat if Discord is not most convenient for you. Please use this form of contact if performance problems arise.

Link to chat: https://chat.socialintents.com/c/shs-chat-support

The game currently runs smoothly even on weaker computers - so there may be problems on some configurations due to settings, drivers, or bugs we don't know yet - let us know, it's Early Access!

Fixes:

 More Fixes to Tools Level System: Additional fixes to ensure the tools leveling system functions properly without glitches.
 Graphics Card Detection: Added automatic detection of the player’s GPU (AMD or NVIDIA) to set optimal settings. Frame Generation and Ray Tracing are now disabled by default, with further optimization of DLSS settings.
 25,000$ House Warehouse Spawn Issue:  Fixed items spawning on the roof, now correctly appearing inside the warehouse.
 Falling Boxes Issue: Resolved the issue of boxes dropping from the sky.
 Chest Item Blockage Fix:  Fixed items getting stuck inside chests.
 Small Items Disappearance Fix:  Addressed issues with small items disappearing unexpectedly.
 Start Trailer Sale Restored: Re-enabled the option to sell the starting trailer.
 Gameplay Change - Faster Repairs: Instant repairs now happen at the correct level based on the item's condition.



What’s next? 

 Architect Mode: A bug causing players to lose items placed via Architect mode is being worked on.
 Additional Bug Fixes: Smaller, non-game-breaking bugs reported on forums and Discord will also be addressed in future patches.


And we'll start doing playability tweaks and do a roadmap survey :)

These updates address some of the more frustrating bugs players encountered, like the spawning issues and disappearing items, making gameplay smoother. T

The ongoing effort to enhance system performance, especially with GPU detection, should also reduce hardware-related issues and provide a better experience for a broader range of players.

Storage Hunter Team

notes.title: Hotfix #1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

We’ve just released a hotfix to address some of the most common issues - verification and repair tools and save files carried over from the demo.

Bug Fixes:
Tool App Issue: We fixed a bug where the Tool app would appear empty, preventing players from purchasing new tools.

Demo Save Compatibility: A major issue with demo saves carrying over to Early Access has been resolved. Corrupted demo saves were causing crashes and performance problems.

Solution: Demo saves are no longer accessible in the Early Access version.

If you are still encountering crashes or performance issues, you may need to manually delete the demo saves (instructions below). If problems persist, reach out to us, and we’ll help you resolve them.

How to Delete Old Demo Saves:
1. Go to: C:\Users\[YourUsername]\AppData\Local\StorageHunter

Replace [YourUsername] with your actual username. The drive might differ depending on where you installed the game.

2. Delete the StorageHunter folder. Warning: This will remove all your saved progress.

If you continue to experience issues after deleting the demo saves, please don't hesitate to contact us for further assistance!

notes.title: STORAGE HUNTER - DEMO VERSION
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We’re super excited to bring you the demo version of Storage Hunter Simulator! 

Quests
- Main Questline: Follow a step-by-step questline that introduces you to the world of storage bidding, covering all aspects of the game.
- Free Gameplay: Keep the fun going with endless gameplay. Expand your storage empire by constantly generating new garages to bid on.

Auctions
- Take Part in Auctions: Don't be shy—lay down some cash for bigger profits. Take part in auctions and aim to get the best storage prices.
- Better and Better Storages: Gain experience and unlock higher-tier storages with more valuable items.

Items
- Tons of Items to Find: Hunt for over 500 items at auctions, each with different rarity and unique prices. You might even find treasures that fetch big bucks!
- Increase Your Profit: Invest in tools to fix items and boost their quality, maximizing your profit.
- Legendary Items: If you’re lucky, you might find legendary items. Test them out or sell them for a huge profit.

Pawnshop
- Your Own Place to Sell: Open your own pawnshop and sell items on your terms. Serve customers yourself or hire an employee to handle sales.
- Haggle with Customers: Use your negotiation skills to haggle and get the best prices for your items.


Become the best Storage Hunter and build your legend from scratch. We can’t wait for you to experience everything our game has to offer!
